messages:
sam: Quick watercooler challenge — friendly mug-roast bracket. One-liners only, PG, 1 vote per person. I'll kick it off: "This mug thinks espresso is a personality trait." :coffee:

maria: Love it. Mine: "This mug was single-origin until it met the office sink." :sweat_smile:

alex: "Comes with a built-in meeting reminder: reheats four times." :timer_clock:

pollbot: Poll created: A) Sam B) Maria C) Alex D) Jamal E) Lee — react with :one:/:two:/... to vote or reply with your one-liner to add a write-in.

jamal: Write-in: "This mug is more committed to its coaster than my DMs." :raised_hands:

lee: Write-in: "Has a frequent-fryer loyalty card for the microwave." :microwave:

maria: Also nominate the travel mug on the window sill — "brags about insulation but forgets the lid." :face_with_hand_over_mouth:

alex: Quick tiebreaker rule: winner gets brag emoji on profile for the day. :trophy:

sam: Okay votes rolling in. Low-stakes trash talk only — we love our mugs. Will tally in 10. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

pollbot: Current reactions: :one: 2, :two: 1, :three: 3, :four: 0, :five: 1. (updates automatically)

jamal: "Also, the chipped rim has more character than my 2019 laptop." :laughing:

lee: This was therapeutic. Can we do coasters next week? :raised_hands:

sam: Done — coaster bracket next Wednesday. Winner today: Alex (most :three: votes). Congrats, you get the profile :trophy:. Closing thread. :party_popper:
